items.source: options: A Map of all the available values that can be selected from in the input field. The keys to the map represent the values that are POSTed back from the form and bound to the command object. Map objects stored against the keys are the labels displayed on the form to the user and may be different from the corresponding values posted back by the form. Usually, such a map is supplied as reference data by the controller. You can use any Map implementation, depending on required behavior. For strictly sorted maps, you can use a SortedMap (such as a TreeMap) with a suitable Comparator and, for arbitrary Maps that should return values in insertion order, use a LinkedHashMap or a LinkedMap from commons-collections.
items.translation: options: 一个 Map，包含可从输入字段中选择的所有可用值。该 Map 的键代表从表单 POST 回来并绑定到命令对象的值。与键关联的 Map 对象是显示在表单上的标签，可能与表单 POST 回来的对应值不同。通常，控制器会作为参考数据提供此类 Map。您可以根据所需行为使用任何 Map 实现。对于严格排序的 Map，您可以使用带有合适 Comparator 的 SortedMap（例如 TreeMap），而对于需要按插入顺序返回值的任意 Map，请使用 LinkedHashMap 或来自 commons-collections 的 LinkedMap。

items.source: <@spring.bind> requires a 'path' argument, which consists of the name of your command object (it is 'command', unless you changed it in your controller configuration) followed by a period and the name of the field on the command object to which you wish to bind. You can also use nested fields, such as command.address.street. The bind macro assumes the default HTML escaping behavior specified by the ServletContext parameter defaultHtmlEscape in web.xml.
items.translation: <@spring.bind> 需要一个 'path' 参数，该参数由命令对象的名称（默认为 'command'，除非您在控制器配置中更改了它）后跟一个点和命令对象上希望绑定其上的字段名称组成。您还可以使用嵌套字段，例如 command.address.street。bind 宏假设遵循在 web.xml 中的 ServletContext 参数 defaultHtmlEscape 指定的默认 HTML 转义行为。

items.source: The formTextarea macro works the same way as the formInput macro and accepts the same parameter list. Commonly, the second parameter (attributes) is used to pass style information or rows and cols attributes for the textarea.
items.translation: formTextarea 宏的工作方式与 formInput 宏相同，并接受相同的参数列表。通常，第二个参数 (attributes) 用于传递样式信息或 textarea 的 rows 和 cols 属性。

items.source: The formInput macro takes the path parameter (command.name) and an additional attributes parameter (which is empty in the upcoming example). The macro, along with all other form generation macros, performs an implicit Spring bind on the path parameter. The binding remains valid until a new bind occurs, so the showErrors macro does not need to pass the path parameter again — it operates on the field for which a binding was last created.
items.translation: formInput 宏接受 path 参数（即 command.name）以及一个额外的 attributes 参数（在即将出现的示例中为空）。该宏连同所有其他表单生成宏一样，会对路径参数执行隐式的 Spring 绑定。绑定在发生新的绑定之前保持有效，因此 showErrors 宏无需再次传递路径参数——它操作的是上次创建绑定的字段。

items.source: An alternative form of the macro called <@spring.bindEscaped> takes a second argument that explicitly specifies whether HTML escaping should be used in the status error messages or values. You can set it to true or false as required. Additional form handling macros simplify the use of HTML escaping, and you should use these macros wherever possible. They are explained in the next section.
items.translation: 另一种形式的宏称为<@spring.bindEscaped>，它接受第二个参数，用于显式指定是否在状态错误消息或值中使用 HTML 转义。您可以根据需要将其设置为true或false。额外的表单处理宏简化了 HTML 转义的使用，您应尽可能使用这些宏。它们将在下一节中介绍。

items.source: Some of the macros defined in the Spring templating libraries are considered internal (private), but no such scoping exists in the macro definitions, making all macros visible to calling code and user templates. The following sections concentrate only on the macros you need to directly call from within your templates. If you wish to view the macro code directly, the file is called spring.ftl and is in the org.springframework.web.servlet.view.freemarker package.
items.translation: Spring 模板库中定义的一些宏被视为内部（私有）的，但宏定义中不存在此类作用域限制，这使得所有宏对调用代码和用户模板可见。以下部分仅集中于您需要在模板中直接调用的宏。如果您希望直接查看宏代码，该文件名为 spring.ftl，位于 org.springframework.web.servlet.view.freemarker 包中。

items.source: separator: Where multiple options are available as discreet elements (radio buttons or checkboxes), the sequence of characters used to separate each one in the list (such as <br>).
items.translation: separator：当有多个选项作为独立元素（单选按钮或复选框）时，用于在列表中分隔每个元素的字符序列（例如 <br>）。

items.source: attributes: An additional string of arbitrary tags or text to be included within the HTML tag itself. This string is echoed literally by the macro. For example, in a textarea field, you may supply attributes (such as 'rows="5" cols="60"'), or you could pass style information such as 'style="border:1px solid silver"'.
items.translation: attributes：包含在 HTML 标签本身内的任意标签或文本的附加字符串。该字符串由宏逐字回显。例如，在 textarea 字段中，您可以提供属性（如 'rows="5" cols="60"'），或者传递样式信息，如 'style="border:1px solid silver"'。

items.source: Apache FreeMarker is a template engine for generating any kind of text output from HTML to email and others. The Spring Framework has built-in integration for using Spring MVC with FreeMarker templates.
items.translation: Apache FreeMarker 是一个模板引擎，可用于从 HTML 到电子邮件等各种文本输出。Spring Framework 已内置集成，支持使用 Spring MVC 与 FreeMarker 模板。

items.source: Default usage of the form macros described earlier results in HTML elements that are HTML 4.01 compliant and that use the default value for HTML escaping defined in your web.xml file, as used by Spring’s bind support. To make the elements be XHTML compliant or to override the default HTML escaping value, you can specify two variables in your template (or in your model, where they are visible to your templates). The advantage of specifying them in the templates is that they can be changed to different values later in the template processing to provide different behavior for different fields in your form.
items.translation: 默认使用前面描述的表单宏会生成符合 HTML 4.01 标准的 HTML 元素，并使用您在 web.xml 文件中定义的 HTML 转义默认值（与 Spring 的 bind 支持中使用的相同）。若要使元素符合 XHTML 标准或覆盖默认的 HTML 转义值，您可以在模板（或在您的模型中，只要它们对模板可见）中指定两个变量。在模板中指定它们的优点是，可以在模板处理的稍后阶段将它们更改为不同的值，从而为您的表单中的不同字段提供不同的行为。

items.source: Spring provides a tag library for use in JSPs that contains, among others, a <spring:bind/> element. This element primarily lets forms display values from form-backing objects and show the results of failed validations from a Validator in the web or business tier. Spring also has support for the same functionality in FreeMarker, with additional convenience macros for generating form input elements themselves.
items.translation: Spring 提供了一个用于 JSP 的标签库，其中包含（除其他外）一个<spring:bind/>元素。该元素主要用于让表单显示来自表单后备对象的值，并展示 Web 层或业务层中Validator的验证失败结果。Spring 还支持 FreeMarker 中的相同功能，并提供了用于生成表单输入元素的额外便捷宏。
